def merge_intervals(intervals):
    intervals.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    merged = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(intervals):
        start = intervals[i][0]
        end = intervals[i][1]
        j = i
        while j < len(intervals) and end >= intervals[j][0]:
